PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 1
ACT I OF 2021
UNIVERSITY OF FAISALABAD (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2021
An Act to amend the University of Faisalabad
Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
17th March, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-3(54)/2020/2492, dated 17.3.2021.---The University of Faisalabad (Amendment) Bill 2021, having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on February 23, 2021, and assented to
by the Governor of the Punjab on March 16, 2021, is hereby published as an Act
of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the University of Faisalabad Ordinance, 2002 (LX of
2002), in the manner hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the University of Faisalabad (Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment in section 2 of Ordinance LX of 2002

Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Amendment
in section 2 of Ordinance LX of 2002.---In the University of Faisalabad Ordinance, 2002 (LX of 2002),
hereinafter referred to as the Ordinance, in section 2, after clause (h), the
following new clause (ha) shall be inserted:
"(ha)
"Punjab Higher Education Commission" means the Punjab Higher
Education Commission set up under the Punjab Higher Education Commission Act
2014 (I of 2015);".

3. Amendments
in section 4 of Ordinance LX of 2002.---In the Ordinance, in section 4:
(i) in
clause (a), for sub-clause (i), the following shall be substituted;
"(i) "Information Technology, Management Sciences, Sciences
(Mathematics, Physics and others), Humanities and Social Sciences (Economics,
Islamiat and others), Law, Fashion and Textile, Languages and Literature
(English, Arabic and other languages), Professional Health Technologies,
Medicine, Pharmacy and Allied Health Sciences, Arts, Design and Architecture
and Education; and"; and
(ii) for
clause (g), the following shall be substituted;
"(g)
to decide teaching methods and strategies including virtual, on-campus, online,
distance learning etc in order to ensure the most effective educational and
training programs."
